description: Réseau Routier National de la RDC / DRC National Roads Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap RDC. Tout le réseau des 44 routes nationales de la République démocratique du Congo, extrait de la base de données OpenStreetMap. Les données sont disponibles dans un jeu de données reprenant les 44 relations (chaque route nationale correspondant à un objet), ou reprenant chacun des segments de chacune des routes nationales avec ses propriétés spécifiques. Coverage: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the. The portal files it under the publisher OpenStreetMap RDC. Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOPACKAGE, SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
